title: vaccinium arenicola
intro: Vaccinium arenicola, commonly known as the Sand Blueberry, is a species of shrub in the heath family that produces edible blueberries. This plant is rich in antioxidants, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, offering numerous health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help protect against chronic diseases such as heart disease, diabetes, and certain types of cancer. The therapeutic actions of Vaccinium arenicola include its ability to improve cardiovascular health, boost the immune system, and exhibit potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include quercetin, kaempferol, and myricetin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and contribute to its traditional use in herbal medicine.
